reporting_basis: MIXED, with a documented break -- see notes and the Q1/Q2/Q3 source entries below for full detail. UPDATE (2026-09-12): 2026 Q1/H1 interim continues CONSOLIDATED (matching FY2022/2024/2025, not FY2019-2021/2023) -- re-verified explicitly via a bonus Consolidated-vs-Solo comparative disclosure box in each filing, see the '2026 Q1/Q2' source entry below. Q4/annual series (2011-2025): SOLO throughout (the underlying audited Balance Sheet/Profit and Loss Account/Segment-Reporting sources actually used for this dataset's Q4 line items are Solo in all 15 years, independently confirmed per year -- see each source entry below); note that the bank's own compact 'Performance Highlights for Five Years' SUMMARY table (not used directly for Q4 line items except to corroborate) separately drifts from Consolidated-vintage (FY2011-2015) to Solo-vintage (FY2022-2025), which is a different phenomenon from the interim-series mismatch below. Q1/Q2/Q3 interim series (added in a later session, sourced from each annual report's own embedded BSEC-mandated 'Evaluation of (the) Quarterly Financials' corporate-governance table): SOLO for FY2019-FY2021 and FY2023 (FY2023's table is captioned '(consolidated)' but its populated figures are proven Solo -- a mislabelling in the bank's own report, not a basis choice made here); CONSOLIDATED for FY2022, FY2024 and FY2025 (captioned '(consolidated)'/'(Consolidated)' and independently confirmed genuinely so, exact-match, against each of those years' own full Consolidated Balance Sheet/Consolidated Profit and Loss Account). The FY2022/FY2024/FY2025 Consolidated interim figures are a REAL basis mismatch against this dataset's Solo Q4/annual figures for those same three years -- this is repeated in every affected quarter file's own period_note (bank_financials/PREMIERBAN/quarterly/2022_Q{1,2,3}.json, 2024_Q{1,2,3}.json, 2025_Q{1,2,3}.json). UPDATED (2026-08-28 session): FY2011-2018 Q1/Q2/Q3 interim data has since been added (16 of the 24 possible quarters -- see data_gaps), sourced from a THIRD, distinct interim source: the bank's own website 'Financial Reports' archive (thepremierbankplc.com/financial-reports/, plus Wayback Machine captures of its pre-2016 predecessor premierbankltd.com/pbl/financial%20highlight/ and /pbl/wp-content/uploads/reports/half-yearly/ for the quarters no longer linked on the live site), NOT the annual-report-embedded BSEC table used for FY2019-2025 (confirmed exhausted for FY2011-2018 -- see the FY2011-2018 non-existence finding below, unchanged from the prior session). Every one of these 16 newly-added FY2011-2018 quarters is CONSOLIDATED basis (the bank's own newspaper-style quarterly disclosure format prints only a Consolidated Balance Sheet/P&L/Cash Flow/Statement of Changes in Equity for every quarter checked in this span -- no Solo section at all in the main layout), making this a REAL, PERVASIVE mismatch against the Solo Q4/annual series for the ENTIRE FY2011-2018 block -- matching the same CONSOLIDATED pattern as FY2022/2024/2025 above, not the SOLO pattern of FY2019-2021/2023. Four of the sixteen quarters (2016 Q1, 2017 Q3, 2018 Q1, 2018 Q2) additionally carry a bonus 'Price sensitive information' / 'Comparative Statement' / 'Disclosure on Un-audited Financial Statements' box printing BOTH Consolidated and Solo EPS/NAVPS/NOCFPS side by side, which independently proves the Solo/Consolidated gap is real and material in this era too (e.g. 2016 Q1: Consolidated EPS 0.16 vs Solo EPS 0.21) -- these bonus Solo figures are recorded in each affected quarter file's own period_note but NOT used as that file's line_items, which remain Consolidated throughout for internal consistency with the rest of the FY2011-2018 block.
notes: annual_reports/PREMIERBAN archive contains 15 PDFs already text-extracted (pdftotext -layout) prior to this research, spanning the full FY2011-FY2025 span (renamed from 'The Premier Bank Limited' to 'The Premier Bank PLC' starting with the FY2023 report, following Bangladesh's company-law PLC-suffix change). Achieved complete Q4/year-end coverage for all 15 years using: (a) each report's own audited Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account directly, for FY2011-2013 and FY2022-2023; (b) each report's own 'Financial Highlights - The Premier Bank Limited & Consolidated' two-column (current+prior year, explicit Solo vs Consolidated labels) table, for FY2014-2021; (c) each report's own Segment Reporting note under IFRS 8 (which isolates a 'Bank Total' = Conventional + Islamic banking + Off-shore Banking Unit column, distinct from the 'Group Total' that adds subsidiary Premier Bank Securities Ltd), for FY2024-2025. Only Q4/year-end (audited) data was extracted; Q1/H1/Q3 unaudited interim data was not researched, though a usable source (an 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials' table, Solo basis despite an inconsistent '(consolidated)' caption in some reports) was located in the FY2022/FY2023 archives for future backfill work. IMPORTANT FINDING: this bank has had a subsidiary (Premier Bank Securities Ltd, incorporated June 2010; a second subsidiary Premier Money Transfer Company Ltd from Feb 2012) throughout the entire 2011-2025 span, so Solo and Consolidated financial statements diverge materially in every year (e.g. FY2015 Total Assets: Solo 131,006.54m vs Consolidated 131,437.94m, a 0.33% gap). The bank's own compact multi-year summary table changes which basis it reports on ACROSS THE SERIES without ever labelling itself as such: it is Consolidated basis in the FY2011-2015-vintage 'Performance Highlights for Five Years' tables (independently proven via exact matches to each year's own audited Consolidated P&L/Balance Sheet), but Solo basis by the FY2022-2025-vintage 'Performance Highlights for Five Years' tables (independently proven via exact matches to each year's own audited Solo Balance Sheet and to the Segment Reporting note's 'Bank Total' column) - this 'solo vs consolidated drift within one bank's own series' is exactly the trap flagged in the project's reusable-parser reference notes, and required verifying the reporting basis against each year's own labelled Balance Sheet/Segment Reporting statement individually rather than trusting the summary-table format to stay consistent. Capital Strength rows (Tier-1/Tier-2/CAR%) within these same tables were separately and independently confirmed to be Solo throughout (including in the years where the balance-sheet rows are Consolidated), via cross-checks against each report's own Basel II/III Pillar 3 capital-adequacy disclosure notes (explicitly titled 'The Premier Bank Limited', excluding the subsidiary) for FY2011, FY2012, FY2013, FY2016 and FY2017, and via the explicit Solo-labelled 'Financial Highlights' table for FY2014-2021.

sources.source_document: premierban-annual-report-2024.txt (Segment Reporting per IFRS 8, 'Bank Total' column; own 'Performance Highlights for Five Years (2020-2024)' table)
sources.note: Segment Reporting note's 'Bank Total' column (Conventional Banking + Islamic banking branches + Off-Shore Banking Unit, i.e. Solo) independently confirmed identical to this report's own five-year table (Total Assets 449,626.03, PAT 1,454.59 match exactly). This is a sector-wide asset-quality shock year: NPL ratio 4.99%->22.92%, classified loans 14,451.50m->75,527.14m (5.2x), CRAR 13.58%->10.54% (below the ~12.5% Bangladesh Bank minimum-plus-buffer requirement), PBT 5,260.65m->1,457.62m on a provision charge of 6,333.76m. The Solo/Bank entity remained marginally profitable (PAT +1,454.59m) while subsidiary Premier Bank Securities Ltd posted a loss (-112.98m), pulling Consolidated/Group PAT down to 1,341.61m - the first year Solo and Consolidated performance diverge in sign-relevant ways. ARITHMETIC ERROR FOUND AND CORRECTED: this report's own five-year table states 'Reserve and Surplus' of 17,495.42 for FY2024, which is arithmetically impossible against the same table's own Paid-up Capital (12,334.31) and Shareholders' Equity (27,042.86) rows (12,334.31+17,495.42=29,829.73 =/= 27,042.86); the FY2025 report's comparative column instead shows 14,708.54, which reconciles exactly (12,334.31+14,708.54=27,042.85~27,042.86). Per project convention (prefer the arithmetically consistent figure when the contemporaneous one is impossible - see ISLAMIBANK FY2024 capital precedent in the project handoff), 14,708.54 is used here, sourced from the FY2025 report. GAP: roe_pct/roa_pct are calculated (not reported) since this report's own five-year table does not print an Operating Performance Ratio section within the extracted range.

sources.source_document: premierban-annual-report-2025.txt (Segment Reporting per IFRS 8, 'Bank Total' column; own 'Performance Highlights for Five Years 2021-2025' table)
sources.note: Segment Reporting note's 'Bank Total' column independently confirmed identical to this report's own five-year table (Total Assets 423,551.38, PAT -9,785.41 match exactly) and to the separate Consolidated Balance Sheet's broadly similar (but not identical: 423,820.15) Total Assets. The FY2024 asset-quality shock deepened into a full crisis: NPL ratio 22.92%->31.01% (classified loans 75,527.14m->103,893.95m), CRAR collapsed 10.54%->5.70% (roughly half the regulatory minimum-plus-buffer requirement), Interest Expense (29,805.39m) now exceeds Interest Income (23,799.62m) producing a negative Net Interest Income (-6,005.77m), Total Operating Income fell 92% to 1,238.42m, and the Solo entity posted a net loss of -9,785.41m (EPS -7.93) versus a small profit in FY2024. Total assets and deposits both contracted year-on-year and gross loans now exceed deposits (LDR 101.70%). Equity nearly halved (27,042.86 to 17,146.71) from the loss alone but remained positive, so ROE/ROA (calculated period-end, per the negative-equity-breaks-ROE rule) are meaningful large-negative numbers rather than null. Credit rating was downgraded intra-year (Long-term Local AAA->AA; Short-term ST-1->ST-2).

sources.period: 2011-2018 Q1/Q2/Q3 (unaudited interim) -- SUMMARY, see the detailed entries immediately below
sources.notes: SESSION GOAL: the prior session confirmed the annual-report-embedded 'Evaluation of (the) Quarterly Financials' BSEC table (used for FY2019-2025 above) does not exist in any FY2011-2018 annual report -- a genuine dead end for that specific method. This session tried a different, previously-untried source per the project's standing premise (confirmed twice already this project, for CITYBANK and UCB, that a bank's own website interim-statements archive can hold 20-30+ more quarters even after the annual-report-table method is exhausted): the bank's own website. FOUND: https://www.thepremierbankplc.com/financial-reports/ (current site; premierbankltd.com redirects here) hosts a 'Quarterly Reports (Pre-2019)' table (Q1/Q3 entries, 2013-2018) and a separate Half-Yearly table (H1 entries, 2016-2023) -- a genuinely different, richer source than the annual-report table, confirming the task's premise once again. Raw HTML was fetched directly (not via the AI-summarised WebFetch tool) and parsed row-by-row to get an exhaustive, un-summarised link listing, since a page with ~60 document rows risks silent omissions from an LLM-summarised fetch. RESULT: 13 of the 24 possible FY2011-2018 quarters were directly downloadable from the live site (Q1/Q3 2013-2017, Q1/Q2 2018, plus H1 2016/2017 -- the H1 table only goes back to 2016). The remaining quarters were pursued via Wayback Machine CDX search (both premierbankltd.com and thepremierbankplc.com domains, ~52,000 total captures scanned across several targeted queries) against the bank's pre-2016 site structure (premierbankltd.com/pbl/financial%20highlight/ and its 2016-era successor /pbl/wp-content/uploads/reports/half-yearly/), recovering 3 more genuine quarters (2011 Q3, H1 2013, H1 2014) for a total of 16/24 found. Internet Archive's replay service (web.archive.org/web/...) was intermittently down ('Temporarily Offline', a service-wide outage not specific to this bank) during this session and required several retries spaced a few seconds to tens of seconds apart before succeeding -- the CDX index API (web.archive.org/cdx/...) remained available throughout and was used continuously to plan retrieval even while replay was down. GENUINE GAPS (8 quarters, all confirmed via exhaustive CDX search with no positive result, not merely unattempted): 2011 Q1, 2011 Q2/H1 (no capture of any kind found anywhere in either domain -- 2011 Q3 is the earliest 2011 quarterly data that exists at all); all of 2012 Q1/Q2/Q3 (same -- zero captures); 2015 Q2/H1 ('Half_Yearly_Financial_Position_2015_Final.pdf' returns a genuine HTTP 404 in BOTH of its two Wayback captures, 2018-03-04 and 2020-07-19 -- the file was actually broken/missing on the bank's own server both times it was crawled, not an access problem on this end; no alternate filename or path for a 2015 H1 report was found anywhere after a broad keyword sweep); 2015 Q3 (the live site's 'Q3, 2015' download link is a mislabelled duplicate -- see the 2016_Q1.json entry below -- and no genuine, distinct Q3-2015 file was found via Wayback either); 2018 Q3 (the live site's table has an empty row for this slot -- literal 'Download' text with no href, i.e. the bank never attached a file -- and the corresponding 'financialreport/q3-2018' and 'investors_relation/price-sensitive-information-on-3rd-quarter-2018' pages on the live current site are empty template/archive pages with no embedded data or linked document). All 8 gaps are recorded as unavailable in the respective quarterly files (i.e. simply not created), not fabricated or backfilled from adjacent quarters or annual data, per project convention. BASIS FINDING: unlike the FY2019-2025 block above (which splits SOLO/CONSOLIDATED by year), every one of the 16 FY2011-2018 quarters found is CONSOLIDATED -- the bank's newspaper-style quarterly disclosure format used throughout this era prints only a Consolidated Balance Sheet/P&L/Cash Flow/Statement of Changes in Equity, with no Solo section in the main layout in any quarter checked. Four quarters (2016 Q1, 2017 Q3, 2018 Q1, 2018 Q2) carry a bonus box also showing Solo EPS/NAVPS/NOCFPS, which is recorded in the period_note of those four quarterly files as a cross-check but not used as line_items. All 16 files pass balance-sheet identity (Assets=Liabilities+Equity) and internal P&L identity (NII=Interest Income-Interest Expense; Total Operating Income=NII+non-interest income; Profit before provision=TOI-TOE; Profit before taxation=PBP-Provision; PAT=PBT-Tax) to the exact taka, and equity components sum exactly to Total Shareholders' Equity in every case.

sources.source_document: qy3_2011.zip -> bs.jpg / con_pl.jpg / cash_flow.jpg / equity.jpg (four scanned exhibit images comprising the Consolidated Balance Sheet, Consolidated Profit and Loss Account, Consolidated Cash Flow Statement and Statement of Changes in Equity, each headed 'for the quarter ended 30 September' / 'as at 30 September 2011', Un-Audited)
sources.note: The earliest interim (non-annual, non-Q4) quarterly data recovered anywhere in this bank's 15-year series. Recovered via Wayback Machine (capture 2015-04-07) of the bank's old pre-2016 domain path -- not linked from the current thepremierbankplc.com/financial-reports/ page, whose earliest Q1/Q3 entries start at 2013. Basis: CONSOLIDATED (all four exhibits are explicitly captioned 'Consolidated'). Internally cross-validated three ways: balance-sheet identity (Total Liabilities 68,029,402,725 + Total Shareholders' Equity 6,085,325,375 = Total Assets 74,114,728,100, to the taka), P&L identity (Total Operating Income 2,952,505,119 - Total Operating Expenses 1,337,967,186 - Total provision 638,049,605 - Tax 648,902,256 = Profit after taxation 327,586,072), and the Statement of Changes in Equity's own roll-forward (Balance at 01 Jan 2011 6,277,115,732 + Net profit for the year 327,586,072 - Transfer to statutory reserve/general reserve - bonus shares issued for 2010 + minority interest = Balance at 30 Sep 2011 6,085,325,375, to the taka). ODDITY (not treated as an error): the Off-Balance Sheet Items exhibit's own comparative-column headers read '30.06.2011 / 30.12.2010' instead of '30.09.2011 / 31.12.2010' used on every other exhibit in the same four-image set -- a typo in the bank's own original document, since the figures on that page tie out only to the Total Off-Balance Sheet Items figure used throughout and to no other period. No Q1 or Q2/H1 2011 filing was found anywhere (see the SUMMARY entry above).

sources.note: Basis: CONSOLIDATED throughout. NOTABLE FINDING: a large Specific Provision (1,747,424,719, cumulative Jan-Jun 2013) drove a big reported net LOSS in H1 2013 (Profit after taxation -1,997,793,950, EPS -3.90), which only partially reversed by Q3 (cumulative Jan-Sep 2013 PAT -1,131,167,585, EPS -2.21 -- implying a discrete Jul-Sep 2013 profit of ~866.6m, printed directly in the Q3 filing's own discrete-quarter P&L column). Retained earnings is negative at both the Jun-2013 (-2,005,280,255) and Sep-2013 (-1,139,897,671) balance-sheet dates as a direct consequence, recovering to positive again by Q1 2014 (661,322,908). This is a genuine, internally-corroborated reported event (independently confirmed via each file's own Statement of Changes in Equity roll-forward), not a transcription error, and is unrelated to the FY2024-2025 asset-quality crisis documented elsewhere in this dataset -- it predates it by over a decade. sources.source_document: premierban-q1-2026.pdf ('1st Quarter Financial Statements 2026 (Un-Audited)'); premierban-h1-2026.pdf ('Half Yearly Financial Statements 2026 (Un-Audited)') -- both single-page designed-infographic PDFs, a materially richer NEW source than the annual-report-embedded 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials' table used for 2019-2025 (full Balance Sheet, P&L, Statement of Changes in Equity and Cash Flow Statement, all labelled Consolidated, plus a bonus Consolidated-vs-Solo 'Comparative Statement'/EPS disclosure box)
sources.note: *** BASIS MISMATCH CONTINUES: both 2026 quarters are genuinely CONSOLIDATED, not Solo/Bank-Total, matching the pattern already established for FY2022/2024/2025 (not FY2019/2020/2021/2023, which were Solo) -- explicitly re-verified rather than assumed, per project standing instruction for this bank. *** PROOF: (1) each filing's own 31-Dec-2025 comparative column (Total Assets 423,820.15m) reproduces exactly against the FY2025 Consolidated Balance Sheet already on file, not the FY2025 Solo figure (423,551.38m); (2) each filing carries its own bottom-right 'Disclosure on Un-audited Financial Statements' box giving a direct Consolidated-vs-Solo comparison: Q1 NAV BDT 1,569.96 crore (Consolidated) vs 1,613.46 crore (Solo), EPS (0.87) vs (0.83); H1 NAV BDT 1,288.00 crore (Consolidated) vs 1,332.06 crore (Solo), EPS (3.15) vs (3.10) -- a real, small, consistent gap, same magnitude as prior Consolidated-basis years. Both PDFs were downloaded, read visually at 300dpi (not OCR'd -- clean typeset tables), and deleted after extraction per project convention (no annual_reports/PREMIERBAN/*.txt equivalent exists for these, since they are single infographic pages, not the usual annual-report text archive). Internally validated: balance-sheet identity holds exactly both quarters; Total Operating Income - Total Operating Expenses = Profit before Provision = PBT (nil provision both quarters) - Tax = PAT, exact to the taka both quarters. Cross-quarter validation: Q1 PAT (-1,077.28m) + bonus discrete-Q2 PAT from the H1 filing's own 4-column P&L (-2,810.50m) = -3,887.78m, matching the H1 filing's own cumulative PAT (-3,887.79m) to within BDT 0.01m rounding. The FY2024-2025 crisis continues deepening: Consolidated Net Interest Income is negative in both quarters (Q1 -1,243.60m, H1 cumulative -3,158.52m), and the discrete Q2 loss (-2,810.50m) is larger than the Q1 loss (-1,077.28m). Full detail in bank_financials/PREMIERBAN/quarterly/2026_Q1.json, 2026_Q2.json.
